newsitem.title: USA: Quantech pursuing financing for system.
newsitem.headline: Quantech pursuing financing for system.

text.p: Quantech Ltd., which is developing a diagnostic system which performs blood tests, said it is pursuing financing through a private placement of debt and warrants.
The funds will be used to complete a submission to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration of its system and to begin commercial launch of the product. The amount was not disclosed.

Earlier, Quantech reported a fiscal 1997 third quarter net loss of $1,121,882 compared with a loss of $520,331 in the third quarter of last year. For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, Quantech's loss was $2,961,093, compared with $1,800,360 in 1996.
Quantech said the loss was due to increased research and development spending and costs of building infrastructure in anticipation of the introduction and production of its medical diagnostic system.

"Quantech's prototypes are successfully providing diagnostic results for various concentrations of the elements for which we are testing," said Joseph Shaw, president, in a statement. "We are currently working to optimize the sensitivity of the system for our submission to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
